label: DATATYPE-ONLY reliability-aware analysis (protection p = none; no protection implemented)
Q_definition: Q = sum_i F_i (w_i - w_hat_i)^2, F = diagonal true Fisher (FP32 model, 1,024 training-split images); w_hat = decoded frozen Stage 2 encoding
R_definition: R = Stage 4 layer-wise mean accuracy drop in percentage points, fault group 'all' (any bit of the stored weight), k = 8, one layer at a time, 20 trials x 1,000 validation images, p = none
notes: Layer-additive scores approximate the full model; the selected assignment must be assembled and measured end to end.
R_scale_any_k1_mean_drop_pp is a different fault process (INT scale words, k = 1) and is not part of R unless a sweep variant says so.
Clean accuracy is a format-level measurement (Stage 2, all layers in the same format); per-layer clean accuracy was not measured.
